control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-9503 and PT-9503 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 September 2024 a corrective action on P-9503 and PT-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
